description:
The NewsReaderApp APK size has ballooned to over 25MB, which is too large for our target market. Use the Android Studio 'APK Analyzer' to identify the cause of this bloat.

1. Build the APK (Build > Build Bundle(s) / APK(s) > Build APK(s)).
2. Analyze the generated 'app-debug.apk' using Build > Analyze APK.
3. Identify the single largest file inside the APK.
4. Locate that file in the source project structure and delete it.
5. Rebuild the APK to verify the size reduction.

Goal: The final debug APK must be under 5MB.
